# Synthetic setpoint protocol

ID? + LF returns BenchWeave Labs,setpoint-demo,SIM-SP1,1.0.0 + LF. LIM? + LF returns the current limit as finite ASCII amperes + LF. LIM <value> + LF returns OK + LF when the device accepts the setpoint, ERR + LF when it rejects it against its own state. No real device is claimed.
